title: [Nichibei] Contract Page – Archived LA Hidden Even When Every Other Visibility Rule Would Show It
description: AC-5 - Decision Table - [UNVERIFIED]: An LA that passes every other documented visibility rule must still be hidden from the Contract page if it is archived - archive must override every other condition.
preconditions:
Learner is logged into the Learner app; the Contract page is accessible
LA-A: slots = 5, requiredAllocation = false, within the configured date range - passes every existing visibility rule
LA-A's Archived_At__c is populated (its order group was fully removed)
steps_actions:
1. "Learner navigates to the Contract page"
2. "Learner checks whether LA-A appears in the list"
steps_result:
1. "Per AC-5, LA-A should not be displayed, since an archived LA must be excluded from every in-scope read path regardless of its other field values"
2. "[UNVERIFIED] Record actual behavior: LA-A correctly hidden (pass), or LA-A still shown because the Contract page's filter doesn't know about Archived_At__c (fail - route to the engineering owner once identified for /lessonAllocation/v2/getPointsConsumption)"
steps_data:
1. "LA-A Archived_At__c = populated; slots = 5; requiredAllocation = false"
2. "Actual result to be captured against live Nichibei org"

title: [Nichibei] Contract Page – List Updates Live After LA Archives – Previously Visible LA Disappears
description: AC-5 - Regression - [UNVERIFIED]: Extends the existing live-update baseline to include archiving as a trigger, consistent with every other field change already confirmed to refresh the list.
preconditions:
LA-B is currently visible on the Contract page (slots > 0, requiredAllocation = false, within date range)
Learner has the Contract page open
steps_actions:
1. "While the Learner has the Contract page open (or reopens it shortly after), HQ or CM Staff archives LA-B by fully removing its order group"
2. "Learner refreshes or reopens the Contract page"
steps_result:
1. "LA-B's Archived_At__c becomes populated"
2. "[UNVERIFIED] Record actual behavior: LA-B disappears (pass), or LA-B remains visible because archiving isn't one of the recognized update triggers (fail)"
steps_data:
1. "LA-B Archived_At__c = populated"
2. "Actual result to be captured against live Nichibei org"

title: [Nichibei] Contract Page – Unarchive – Restored LA Reappears With Correct Purchased Slot, End Date, Remaining Points, and Product Name
description: AC-3 - Regression - [UNVERIFIED]: Inverse of the hide case; once the LA is unarchived on the same record Id, the Contract page must show it again with the correct field values.
preconditions:
LA-B was hidden from the Contract page per the archive case above
A living Student Package Order reappears for the same Student_Course_ID__c group, and LA-B is unarchived on the same record Id (Archived_At__c cleared), with purchased slot, end date, remaining points, and product name unchanged from before the archive
steps_actions:
1. "Learner refreshes or reopens the Contract page after LA-B is restored"
2. "Learner checks the displayed purchased slot, end date, remaining points, and product name for LA-B"
steps_result:
1. "Per AC-3, LA-B should reappear exactly as a normal, never-archived LA would"
2. "[UNVERIFIED] Record actual behavior: all four fields display correctly and match the pre-archive values (pass), or LA-B remains hidden / shows stale or incorrect values (fail - restore is incomplete)"
steps_data:
1. "LA-B Archived_At__c = null (restored, same Id)"
2. "Actual result to be captured against live Nichibei org"

title: [Nichibei] Contract Page – Account Switch – Archived LA Does Not Leak Back In Via a Stale Cached List
description: AC-5 (cross-system) - Regression - [UNVERIFIED]: Extends the existing org-boundary account-switch baseline with the archive dimension - switching away and back must not resurrect an archived LA via a stale client-side cache.
preconditions:
Parent CrossOrg is logged in and linked to Student Nichibei
Student Nichibei has LA-C, visible on the Contract page, which then archives (Archived_At__c populated) while the parent is viewing a different linked student
steps_actions:
1. "Parent CrossOrg views Student Nichibei's Contract page, confirms LA-C is visible, then switches to a different linked student"
2. "While viewing the other student, LA-C archives"
3. "Parent CrossOrg switches back to Student Nichibei and opens the Contract page"
steps_result:
1. "LA-C is visible before the switch"
2. "LA-C's Archived_At__c becomes populated"
3. "[UNVERIFIED] Record actual behavior: LA-C is correctly absent, reflecting its current archived state (pass), or LA-C still appears because the switch restored a stale cached list from step 1 (fail)"
steps_data:
1. "LA-C Archived_At__c = null at this point"
2. "LA-C Archived_At__c = populated"
3. "Actual result to be captured against live Nichibei org"
